mapper.insert: insert into dc_coupon (co_name, co_type, co_val, co_max_amt, co_min_amt, co_scope, co_reason, co_days, co_start, co_end, co_at, p_no) values (#{coName}, #{coType}, #{coVal}, #{coMaxAmt,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{coMinAmt}, #{coScope}, #{coReason}, #{coDays,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{coStart}, #{coEnd}, sysdate, #{pNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: update dc_coupon set co_name = #{coName}, co_type = #{coType}, co_val = #{coVal}, co_max_amt = #{coMaxAmt,jdbcType=INTEGER}, co_min_amt = #{coMinAmt}, co_scope = #{coScope}, co_reason = #{coReason}, co_days = #{coDays,jdbcType=INTEGER}, co_start = #{coStart}, co_end = #{coEnd}, p_no = #{pNo,jdbcType=INTEGER} where co_no = #{coNo}
mapper.select: select c.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason, c.co_days, c.co_start, c.co_end, c.co_at, c.p_no, p.p_title from dc_coupon c left join dc_product p on c.p_no = p.p_no where c.co_no = #{coNo}

select c.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason, c.co_days, c.co_start, c.co_end, c.co_at, c.p_no, p.p_title from dc_coupon c left join dc_product p on c.p_no = p.p_no order by c.co_no desc

select c.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason, c.co_days, c.co_start, c.co_end, c.co_at, c.p_no, p.p_title from dc_coupon c left join dc_product p on c.p_no = p.p_no where sysdate between c.co_start and c.co_end and not exists ( select 1 from dc_member_coupon mc where mc.co_no = c.co_no and mc.m_no = #{mNo} ) order by c.co_val desc
select p_no as "pNo", p_title as "pTitle", p_brand as "pBrand" from dc_product where p_title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' and rownum <= 20 order by p_no desc
